note: Single figure, clean magenta. Brennic's identity carried over: shaved head, copper beard, ivory cloth with a burnt-orange sash panel, dark short mantle, ember jars on the belt, forked charred staff with an ember, a small flame in the open hand. Inked like the target. Departures: the body faces the viewer nearly frontally instead of front-right, and the flame tips pick up a pink fringe from the matte. Strongest silhouette of the fire set at small scale (pale robe, dark mantle).
method: direct pixel inspection by the builder, side by side with the target
